watches.description: Precision engineering meets understated design in this distinctive Canford Automatic, where considered details, contrasting finishes and purposeful construction come together in a watch that's every bit as capable as it looks. The striking blue fumé dial takes centre stage. Graduating from deep, almost black edges to a lighter blue centre, it creates a rich sense of depth and character that changes with the light. A fine engraved circular keyline adds a crisp, technical detail, while bold, tapered dagger-shaped applied indices ensure clarity at a glance. The marine-grade stainless steel case is all about precision. Finely brushed surfaces contrast with subtle polished highlights, creating clean, defined lines that catch the light without demanding attention. Every surface, edge and transition has been carefully considered. Underneath the refined exterior is the uncompromising engineering you'd expect from Elliot Brown. Triple-sealed screw-down twin crowns, a bolted-down compressor case back, solid steel interchangeable strap bars and a substantial 3mm domed sapphire crystal are all engineered for long-term durability. Inside, a 24-jewel automatic movement with shock protection delivers dependable mechanical performance. No unnecessary fuss. Just thoughtful design, proper materials and the kind of attention to detail that makes our watches unmistakably different.

watches.name: CANFORD AUTOMATIC: 303-A65
watches.description: There's something undeniably right about a classic black dial and stainless steel case. It's a combination that's stood the test of time, and for good reason. Precision-brushed and polished steel frames a beautifully balanced black ceramic dial, creating a watch that's as purposeful as it is timeless. Understated at first glance, extraordinary in the details. Every surface, every proportion and every carefully considered component has a purpose. This is timeless design backed by serious engineering, made to stand the test of time in every sense. As daylight fades, multi-layer Super-LumiNova® hands and indexes reveal their brilliance, remaining legible for up to eight hours. Beneath the sapphire crystal, a professional-grade locking inner timing bezel responds to the upper crown with precise, tactile clicks. Every minute positively located. Every adjustment satisfyingly assured. The contrasting matte steel crowns are a pleasure to use, with deeply cut splines for confident grip and embossed ends that speak to their individual functions. Positioned safely at 2 and 4 o’clock, they're protected without compromising ease of use. Military-derived solid steel strap bars provide exceptional security, while our proprietary shock-protection system safeguards the mechanical heart within. And what a heart it is. The Japanese-made Miyota 9015 automatic movement is a triumph of dependable, purposeful engineering. With 24 jewels, built-in Parashock protection and a 42-hour power reserve, it’s built to perform, day after day, year after year. Turn the watch over and its customised rotor and intricate mechanics are revealed through a beautifully domed sapphire exhibition case back. A supple, padded black Horween® leather strap provides the finishing touch, bringing warmth and character to the cool precision of the steel case. Nothing unnecessary. Nothing overlooked. Just a beautifully considered mechanical watch with the substance to back up its style.

watches.name: CANFORD AUTOMATIC: 303-A63
watches.description: If someone had suggested a dark brown fumé dial back in 2010, when the original Canford was little more than a glint in our eye, we'd have laughed it off. Yet here we are, with one of the best-looking watches we've ever made. At first glance, the dial appears almost black, but catch it in the light and the rich brown radial fumé fade reveals itself. It's a beautifully understated combination that gives the A63 a character all of its own. The engraved keyline divides the dial into two distinct halves, framing the EB shield and wordmarks. Polished steel detailing around the date window and tapered dagger applied indices adds a classic touch, while multiple layers of pale green X1-C3 Super-LumiNova® on the hands and indexes ensure excellent nighttime visibility. The vintage racer influence continues with a perforated Italian leather strap in the darkest brown, chosen to complement the dial without competing with it. Tapering from 20mm at the lugs to a discreet 16mm buckle, it adds a touch of classic elegance and makes for an exceptionally comfortable fit. As with all the Canford Autos, the 60-minute inner timing bezel is a pleasure to operate, with bold indexes clicking precisely from marker to marker via the locking upper crown. Both crowns feature contrasting matte steel finishes, high-grip splines and embossed domed ends. The upper crown carries a triangle matching the bezel's 12 o'clock marker, while the lower EB shield crown handles winding, time and date adjustments. Through the domed sapphire exhibition case back sits the high-performance Japanese Miyota 9015 mechanical movement. Just 3.9mm thick, with 24 jewels and a 42-hour power reserve, sitting safely in our proprietary shock protection system.

watches.name: CANFORD AUTOMATIC: 303-A62
watches.description: Is it green, blue or grey? The light decides. Our distinctive NIVO dial reveals subtle shifts in colour depending on its surroundings, giving this Canford Automatic a character all its own. NIVO – Night Invisible Varnish Orfordness – was originally developed at the Orfordness Experimental Research Establishment to camouflage aircraft during night operations. Discovered during our research into lesser-known military colours, it's quickly becoming our signature dial colour, Beautifully understated, is softer than black, more intriguing than grey and rich in history. With no modern RAL or Pantone equivalent, every batch of dial paint is carefully matched using a colour spectrometer, resulting in subtle variations that make each production run unique. The historic colour palette continues through a perfectly matched Tectuff® strap, with a brushed, stitched, matt leather-like finish that's exceptionally resistant to the elements. Steel-framed dagger indexes and numerals are generously filled with pale green X1C3 Super-LumiNova®, complementing the matt NIVO dial. A stealthy black seconds hand almost disappears against the dial, leaving only its vivid red tip visible. Finely balanced polished and brushed steel details, together with the delicate keyline framing our shield and wordmark, lend a refined, purposeful finish. The 60-minute internal timing bezel operates with satisfyingly precise clicks via the upper crown. Both crowns feature contrasting matt steel finishes, deep-grip splines and embossed ends, each with its own distinctive insignia. Unbreakable solid steel strap bars, borrowed from our military collections, provide exceptional security while making strap changes effortless. At its heart is the high-performance Japanese Miyota 9015 automatic movement, visible through a domed sapphire case back. With 24 jewels, a 42-hour power reserve and built-in Parashock protection, further enhanced by our proprietary shock protection system, it delivers dependable performance wherever life takes you. Understated, distinctive and quietly capable. Just as we like it.

watches.name: BLOXWORTH HERITAGE DIVER: OBSIDIAN 929-111
watches.description: A darker expression of our original dive watch, Bloxworth Obsidian pairs deep black ceramic with brushed steel, flashes of mirror polish and pop of colour to make things interesting. Inspired by the classic dive watches of the 1950s, it takes everything we love about our Heritage Diver and gives it a sharper, darker edge. Sleek and polished when you want it to be; a proper, fit-for-purpose diver when you need it to be. The wave-embossed black dial and gloss ceramic bezel sit in stark contrast to the brushed steel case, while mustard yellow pips at the hour markers, on the reflector ring and on the tip of the seconds hand adds an unexpected hit of warmth and playfulness. Don’t let the brushed surfaces and good looks fool you, though. Every ounce of that detailing has been engineered to perform in the harshest environments, with Elliot Brown toughness running right through it. There’s elegant simplicity in abundance, but one glance at the spec tells you this is still very much a workhorse. One thing the spec won’t tell you is the little Easter egg we’ve hidden for those with an eagle eye. A shallow box s apphire crystal, toughened and anti-reflective is framed by a precision-engineered, 120-click ceramic diver’s bezel with exceptionally clear markings. A finely polished steel highlight gives way to vertically machined splines around the coin edge, sitting just proud enough of the case to give positive grip and easy handling, even with a gloved hand. At 40mm, it’s designed to sit comfortably on just about any wrist. The fitted rubber strap uses our beautifully detailed split-buckle deployant and features internal rope breather lines inspired by the view from our harbour-side headquarters. Read more about the rubber straps and check out the Instructions tab for how to cut yours to size. Swap in the matching steel bracelet and Obsidian takes on an altogether smarter character, or throw it on a fabric strap when something more relaxed is called for. The STR-B07 is the one you’ll need to match the case. And, as with every Elliot Brown, looking good is only half the job. Every single watch must pass our stringent testing programme, including a 200m pressure test in water, before we deem it fit for use. We also take watches from every batch and hit them with a 3kg stainless steel pendulum mallet to make sure our movement shock-protection system is doing exactly what it should. That’s an impact of around 500G, in case you were wondering. None of this is mandatory. We just think it should be. Which means whether Obsidian ends up beneath a shirt cuff, beneath the waves or somewhere considerably less hospitable, you can wear it with complete confidence – backed by our no-nonsense five-year warranty.

watches.name: HOLTON AUTOMATIC: 101-A12
watches.description: Description This Holton Automatic is something special. A stunning brushed bronze PVD 316L stainless case mounted on the most technical slice of super soft, durable webbing with its low profile patented buckle. Few watches are blessed with this level of natural in-built style yet it's no look at me fancy pants either. The Brief: capable of prolonged exposure to water and dust, durable, shock resistant, clear visibility day or night, unidirectional ultra high grip timing bezel operable with a gloved hand, easy strap changes and comfortable strapping options that don't break. The specification of the bezel gives a perfect insight into the level of detail required for the project to be successful. A precise 120 click ultra high grip bezel houses a stainless steel insert precisely embossed with hours and minutes indentations then flooded with high grade C3 SuperLuminova®. The hobnail outer knurling is slightly higher than the insert to form a high grip surface for trustworthy operation even when using the palm of a wet gloved hand. Both components are matt bead blasted, hardened to 1200HV (Vickers hardness scale) then a 0.8 micron PVD coating is applied whose hardness matches that of the stainless steel components. N.B. this bezel is unapologetically fit for purpose. Please be warned it is likely to catch or wear shirt cuffs etc. The bronze finish has a gorgeously warm worn-in look right from the off, the polar opposite of so many 'shiny' time pieces. This one sits quietly, confidently only getting noticed by those who know yet viewed close up, it's a show stopper. Subtle military cues of Holton Professional toned back with warm vintage hues, yet a technical tour de force capable of more than any human. And of course with its workhorse NH35 automatic self winding movement, it's as happy off grid for as long as you are. The last two photos are stills taken from a video of a quartz Holton and a Kimmeridge strapped to an ROV in the Gulf of Mexico in March 2020, still working at 3900ft - almost 3/4 mile underwater. As our way of saying thank you to serving and ex serving military personnel, we offer 20% military and 'blue light' discount on all our watches. Please email sales@elliotbrownwatches.com with proof of service and to find out more. Our returns policy is on our site here , and our five year warranty is outlined here . watches.name: ARNE: CALI NOIR 606-006
watches.description: The Cali Noir brings back one of our most sought-after finishes: the distressed vintage PVD case from the original Arne field watch, which sold out in just three minutes. Paired with a ceramic dial so deep black it feels almost bottomless, makes this a combination that's hard to ignore. The California dial, or "Cali dial", is instantly recognisable for its distinctive mix of Roman numerals on the upper half of the dial and Arabic numerals on the lower half. The design first appeared on military watches of the 1930s and 1940s, where its unusual layout was intended to maximise legibility and help reduce reading errors in demanding conditions. With this particular Cali Arne, we've taken the watch back to those military roots. The choice of straps lets you lean into its stealthy character: understated black leather, rugged olive webbing or, if you want to soften the look without losing the adventure-ready feel, premium off-white Alcantara.

watches.name: HOLTON: NIVO Bronze
watches.description: Bezel: high grip, uni directional divers bezel case hardened to 1200HV Vickers with matt PVD coating whose hardness matches that of the hardened bezel. The high grip texture enables the bezel to be turned by gripping the sides or pressing downwards and the fine hobnail pattern ensures the bezel can't be caught on anything, turning it accidentally Case: 316L stainless, plated in IP bronze at twice the typical industry thickness without loss of definition on case detailing. Every watch is individually pressure tested to 200m at several points during production Crown: easy to use yet highly protected. Deeply recessed, screws down into watch case, triple sealed, hobnail knurling for secure grip, 4H position keeps it out of harms way. Dial: NIVO colour, anti-reflective, easy to read at a glance day or night with a military bearing that’s relevant and familiar. The hour markers are bold luminous sand green parallelograms reminiscent of 1970s military dive watches, brought up to date with our trademark 12-3-6-9 cardinal graphics, with a bold triangle at 12H to help orientate the watch when it’s dark Hands: clear differentiation between hours, minutes and seconds hands with minimal chance of confusion. Short stubby ‘sword’ hour hand, long slender parallel minutes hand with pointed tip that reaches precisely to the minute markers, both infilled with pink sand Superluminova. The seconds hand has a fine yellow painted tip and luminous filled arrow head counterbalanced by a dark gunmetal ‘lollipop’ Crystal: bevelled 2.8mm sapphire with anti reflective coating applied to the inner surface to minimise glare for perfect visibility in all light conditions. Movement: Swiss Made 5 jewel Ronda calibre 715 with low-battery/end of life indicator that prevents the watch being issued with a low battery. It is housed inside a proprietary shock protection system consisting of a steel housing suspended by elastomer shock absorbers. watches.name: BEACHMASTER AUTOMATIC: D-DAY 80TH LIMITED EDITION
watches.description: As the only British watch business to hold the coveted Armed Forces Covenant Gold Award, we are delighted to launch this rare and very special Beachmaster in collaboration with the Spirit of Normandy Trust (SONT) . Beachmaster’s patented mission timer is a world first conceived around D-Day; a more fitting way for us to mark the 80th Anniversary is hard to imagine. We'll be donating 10% of the sale price to SONT to help take our D-Day and Normandy Veterans back to France for the anniversary. Limited to just 80 pieces worldwide, each case back is numbered and personalised with your own individual engraving. Each watch will be accompanied by a fantastic collection of memorabilia including: a special edition coin, a limited edition print by military artist and SONT friend, Indigo Zulu Ink , a special commemorative book with forewords from SONT Patron, Lord Dannatt, vignettes from some of the Veterans and a special poem by SONT supporter Rob Aitchison. To top all that off, one of the Veterans will pick a number between 1 and 80 at random. The corresponding watch serial number owner will receive an invite, with guest, to attend a special VIP dinner with the Veterans before they head back for the 80th. The Watch Details: Look closer and bespoke details subtly included within this exclusive model begin to reveal their own story. Highlights include the marker below 6 o'clock/30 minutes picked out in blue, symbolising the start of D-Day at 0630. Brushed bronze hands with vintage sand SuperLuminova and dark brown leather strap are a nod to the era, whilst the deeply stamped and etched case back details the beaches and English Channel. The inner mission timing bezel couldn't be simpler to operate. Imagine you’re nine hours out from mission start, simply rotate the split scale inner bezel via the upper crown and set it nine hours in advance of the GMT hand. The GMT hand will count around the bezel scale to H hour, mission start, then automatically begin it’s journey around the second half of the split inner bezel, counting up to a rendezvous say 11 hours after H hour, mission start. At the same time it’s a GMT automatic with ceramic 60 minute uni-directional divers bezel. Powered by a high grade Swiss Sellita SW330-2 Automatic with 56h power reserve, a heart encased in body armour within a highly effective movement shock protection system. The dial is deftly split into outer and inner dials divided by the finest metallic border, framing a textured inner dial with subtle wavy texture, created from the NATO symbol for amphibious assault. A double arrow GMT hand is simultaneously capable of displaying a second time zone via the inner 24h track whilst also referencing the split inner 24h timing bezel for mission timing duties. View the watch at night or in poor visibility and everything changes. High grade Superluminova glows blue for mission timing and green for normal time checks. Simple, functional, elegant. The case back is of course perfectly straight and true because it’s precisely bolted down, compressing the oversized seal perfectly whilst tensioning the movement shock protection system. If the watch descends into a high pressure environment, the case back seal increases effectiveness like a compressor case back. One turn of the high grip upper mission timing crown is all you need to ‘feel’ the obsessive pursuit of detailed perfection. As the inner bezel moves, spring-loaded ceramic ball bearings plunge in and out of precisely machined chambers, securing the bezel at the required mission start time. If you enjoy mechanically satisfying objects, you’ll appreciate the skills required to deliver a detail so functional but delightful to operate. watches.description: Description The Bloxworth ‘105 has vintage character running through its veins. It starts with the precise brushed and polished surfaces of the 40mm stainless case, perfectly melding into one another with hints of high polish that set off against finely brushed and matt vapour blasted finishes. Take the coin edged bezel with matt, vertical high grip splines that protrude just enough for perfect, secure grip, then transition into a highly polished chamfer framing the scratch resistant, lozenge smooth ceramic bezel insert. There’s a sapphire ‘box’ domed crystal with hints of bluey purple thanks to it’s fine anti reflective inner coating. Sitting beneath lies a dual layer ‘sandwich’ dial with bold, soft tan luminous markers and matching pale sand colour infill on the square profile hands, framed in matt gunmetal with a bright orange tip adding a sporting contrast to the seconds hand. The recessed inner dial is finished with a sunray brushed surface that reflects light very differently to the gloss piano black upper layer with railway track outer minutes markings. A fitted dark brown matt leather strap absorbs the light into its richly coloured knapped surface. Over time it develops a character all of its own as the knap slowly wears into smooth dark brown leather, perfectly complementing the black and tan layered dial. The polished details continue with pebble-like case shoulders and the domed screw-down crown with high grip splines. Positioned at 4H to keep it out of harms way whilst avoiding any wrist pressure, the crown is recessed into the case with three seals working together to prevent water ingress. watches.name: HOLTON AUTO GMT: EBINOX 101-A25
watches.description: We’re always looking to improve where we can and continue to offer our customers the best quality. The EBINOX Holton GMT is the answer to two questions we asked and then prototyped a couple of years ago: If we already hardened the bezel on a Holton (and the Tyneham, before it sold out ) could we harden a whole case, and if so what would it look and feel like? Is a blue Anti-Reflective (AR) coating still the ‘ best ’ finish, especially on our watches with matt black dials? The answer is that the hardened EBINOX case feels smoother and slicker than the standard vapour blasted Holton it’s based on, as the case hardening modifies the surface of the metal, smoothing it out. It’s subtle, but it’s there and everyone who handled the original bare case prototypes in the office loved it. The hardening process also changes the colour of the metal from the cold grey natural matt vapour blast finish to a slightly warmer colour. There isn’t much in it unless you put them side by side but it’s apparent when you do. While we were at it, we also prototyped changing the colour of the AR coating from blue to clear . We’ve used blue since the very first days of Elliot Brown, as in some ways it’s a watchmaking tradition but we'd never tried an alternative, so we thought this would be a good opportunity to see if blue was still the ‘ best ’ AR colour, especially on the black EBINOX dial. The end result is definitely a very different appearance from the blue AR coated sapphire glass we’ve used previously. Especially on a black dial, there’s a new clarity to the graphics that’s very evident ; the glass disappears more somehow. Those two small changes continue to push the Holton range forward keeping it at the forefront of affordable tool watches. #inholtonwetrust (Why EBINOX? — it’s EB-Inox - inox is short for acier inoxydable, French for stainless steel.)

watches.description: The Bloxworth Orange. Inspired by classic dive watches from the 60’s, detailed entirely for today’s demanding audience this second iteration of our heritage classic is literally dripping in colour. A bright orange wave embossed dial and matching strap cause heads to turn and never look old. With a grey blue inner chapter ring warmed through with orange hour indexes this is a playful watch that begs to be shown off. Don’t let the colourful palette and pops of mirror polish on this watch fool, you though. Every ounce of its exquisite detailing is engineered to excel in the harshest environments with ‘EB’ weapons grade DNA fully intact. There’s elegant simplicity in abundance yet glancing at the spec is all you need to know that this is a fit-for-purpose workhorse. One detail the spec doesn't mention is a little easter egg we've included for those with an eagle eye. Subtly domed, toughened, anti-reflective sapphire crystal is perfectly framed by a precision engineered divers 120 click ceramic bezel with the clearest markings. A finely polished steel highlight blends into vertically machined splines of the coin-edged bezel, sitting proud of the watch case just enough for perfect handling even with a gloved hand. At 40mm diameter it’s designed for any wrist size, as is the rubber strap with beautifully detailed split buckle deployant mechanism and internal rope breather lines from our harbour-side headquarters. Read more about the rubber straps and check out the Instructions tab on how to cut to size. Pairing with a matching steel bracelet elevates it to another level of sophistication or match it up with a fabric strap for a dose of chilled style. As with our other watch collections, 100% of our watches must pass a series of stringent tests including a 200m pressure test in water before they are deemed fit for use. We also smash a number of watches from every batch with a 3kg stainless steel pendulum mallet to ensure the movement shock protection system is fully operational. That’s an impact force of circa 500G in case you were wondering. This level of testing is by no means mandatory but it does mean you can have complete confidence, backed up by a no nonsense 5 year warranty.

watches.name: BEACHMASTER AUTOMATIC: 0H0-A01-B07
watches.description: Beachmaster, our apex mission timing watch, 4 years in the making, limited to 500 per model and so original it possesses a patent. Initially imagined in response to a request at a Royal Marines event then finely honed into the most capable watch we have ever put our names to. Aptly named Beachmaster due to it’s natural mission timing link with the D-Day landings. ‘Imagine you’re nine hours out from mission start, simply rotate the split scale inner bezel and set it nine hours in advance of the GMT hand. The GMT hand will count around the bezel scale to H hour, mission start, then automatically begin it’s journey around the second half of the split inner bezel, counting up to a rendezvous say 11 hours after H hour, mission start.’ What is it they say about the simplest ideas..? At the same time it’s a GMT automatic with ceramic 60 minute uni-directional divers bezel. Powered by a high grade Swiss Sellita SW330-2 Automatic with 56h power reserve, a heart encased in body armour within a highly effective movement shock protection system. Every detail of this watch is discreetly ruggedised to shrug off all typical areas of weakness. Every component over engineered to out-perform the demands any human is likely to endure, including 100% testing in water at 300m. This high end specification is further enhanced by subtle story telling, a signature ethos applied to every one of the special project watches we’ve been fortunate enough to create but choose not to talk about due to the discreet nature of the audiences involved. The dial is deftly split into outer and inner dials divided by the finest metallic border, framing a textured inner dial with subtle wavy texture, created from the NATO symbol for amphibious assault. A double arrow GMT hand is simultaneously capable of displaying a second time zone via the inner 24h track whilst also referencing the split inner 24h timing bezel for mission timing duties. View the watch at night or in poor visibility and everything changes. High grade Superluminova glows blue for mission timing and green for normal time checks. Simple, functional, elegant. The case back is of course perfectly straight and true because it’s precisely bolted down, compressing the oversized seal perfectly whilst tensioning the movement shock protection system. If the watch descends into a high pressure environment, the case back seal increases effectiveness like a compressor case back. In the centre zone, the word Beachmaster is deeply stamped and polished above the wave NATO amphibious assault symbol. An octagonal frame represents the ‘spatial placement symbol’ from the NATO APP-6(C) Joint Military Symbology manual, used to control the proportions of all NATO battle space signage. The features don’t stop there. One turn of the high grip upper mission timing crown is all you need to ‘feel’ our obsessive pursuit of detailed perfection. As the inner bezel moves, spring-loaded ceramic ball bearings plunge in and out of precisely machined chambers, securing the bezel at the required mission start time. If you enjoy mechanically satisfying objects, you’ll appreciate the skills required to deliver a detail so functional but delightful to operate. Guiding the eye to each unique function set of the Beachmaster is the work of intense refinement, culminating in carefully curated numeric line weights deployed at ten minute intervals within the matt ceramic bezel without the visual framing often created when adding a minutes track. The bezel design alone imbues Beachmaster with a classy simplicity but as with everything else on this unique time piece, it’s the simplicity that adds to its function. To read on, jump into this blog post from our Journal for the full Beachmaster story. For the full feature set, expand the Specification and Instruction tabs below.

watches.description: Description The Holton Professional was developed in response to a request from a specialist branch of the military who demanded a fit-for-purpose professional watch capable of a life in the field. This version is identical to the 101-001-R06 but is fitted with a 12hr bezel rather than a 60min countdown bezel. To use the 12hr bezel, simply turn it anticlockwise until the hour markers on the bezel correspond to the appropriate time difference and you can read off the time in the second time zone using the hour hand in conjunction with the bezel. If you're struggling to choose between the quartz and automatic versions, we wrote a little article here on the pros and cons of each. The Brief: capable of prolonged exposure to water and dust, durable, shock resistant, clear visibility day or night, unidirectional timing bezel operable with a gloved hand, easy strap changes and comfortable strapping options that don't break. The spec of the bezel gives a perfect insight into the level of detail required for the project to be successful. A precise 120 click high grip bezel houses a stainless steel insert embossed with hours and minutes indentations then flooded with high grade C3 SuperLuminova. The hobnail outer knurling is slightly higher than the insert to form a high grip surface for trustworthy operation even when using the palm of a wet gloved hand. The recessed crown sits neatly out of harms way at 4H whilst retaining the immense water protection afforded by our proprietary triple seals. An additional screw down mechanism locks the crown into the case. The last two photos are stills taken from a video of a Holton and a Kimmeridge strapped to an ROV in the Gulf of Mexico in March 2020, still working at 3900ft - almost 3/4 mile underwater. watches.name: BEACHMASTER AUTOMATIC: Founder's Edition: 0H0-A03-B06
watches.description: Beachmaster - our apex mission timing watch has been four years in the making and so original it's been granted a patent. Named Beachmaster due to its mission timing story based around D-Day landings. Initially imagined in response to a request put to us at a Royal Marines event then honed into the most capable watch we have ever put our names to. Imagine you’re nine hours out from mission start: simply rotate the split scale inner bezel using the upper crown and set it nine hours in advance of the GMT hand. The GMT hand will travel around the bezel scale, counting down towards H hour (- mission start) and then continue its journey around the second half of the split inner bezel, counting up to a rendezvous at a predetermined time after H hour. As well as its timing functionality Beachmaster is also an automatic 'caller' GMT automatic with a jumping GMT hand as well as an external ceramic 60 minute uni-directional countdown bezel. The case back is of course perfectly straight and true because it’s precisely bolted down, compressing the oversized seal perfectly whilst tensioning the movement shock protection system. In the centre, the Beachmaster wordmark is deeply stamped above the wave NATO amphibious assault symbol. An octagonal frame represents the ‘spatial placement symbol’ from the NATO APP-6(C) Joint Military Symbology manual, used to control the proportions of all NATO battle space signage. One turn of the high grip upper mission timing crown is all you need to feel our obsessive pursuit of detailed perfection. As the inner bezel moves, spring-loaded ceramic ball bearings click in and out of precisely machined chambers, securing the bezel precisely where required. To read on, jump into this blog post from our Journal for the full Beachmaster story. For the full feature set, expand the Specification and Instruction tabs below.

watches.name: BEACHMASTER AUTOMATIC: 0H0-A02-B12
watches.description: One of our proudest days in the history of EB so far – we’ve been granted our second patent, this time for a watch. Not a part of a watch, or a component, or an improvement. A completely unique, brand new type of watch designed from scratch as a hybrid mission timer/GMT watch. We don’t know the last time a watch with brand new functionality was patented, but we think it’s 68 years – when Rolex invented the original GMT Master I. After four years in development, innumerable revisions, and several false starts when the dual-bezel case proved incredibly difficult to machine, we couldn’t be prouder of the end result – the Beachmaster. The black dial, black bezel and brushed steel case combination of the A01, is fast becoming our signature look. It's possibly the best looking watch we have ever put our names to and so easy to wear on our bracelet or equally at home on our textured rubber strap and deployant butterfly buckle. Capable of being as simple or as complex as the wearer’s requirements demand day to day, as a GMT watch it displays local time in hours, minutes, and seconds as well a second time zone in 24hr format. However, combining the GMT movement with two independently adjustable rotating bezels with different scales means that it can also be used as a count-down/count-up timer: • Reading the minutes hand in conjunction with the scale on the rotating outer bezel shows the number of minutes until an event-start up to 60 minutes away. • Reading the GMT hand in conjunction with the rotating inner bezel displays either the number of hours until event-start (‘H-hour’), and/or the time since event start. As its name suggests, the Beachmaster was originally designed in response to a Royal Marine’s request for a military mission timer, so the caseback design is a nod to the original design brief and features the octagonal ‘spatial placement symbol’ from the NATO APP-6(C) Joint Military Symbology manual, and the NATO symbol denoting an amphibious assault. As with all our watches, we designed the Beachmaster to the highest spec; a unique luminised matt black ceramic bezel, specified a domed anti reflective sapphire glass, a solid brass internal bezel with ceramic locking ball bearings, a Sellita SW330-2 automatic movement, X1 C3 Superluminova, bespoke hobnailed crowns, and a beautifully machined case with polished shoulders and undercuts and finished it with our trademark screw in strap bars. They’re limited to 500 per model and individually numbered

The spec of the bezel gives a perfect insight into the level of detail required for the project to be successful. A precise 120 click high grip bezel houses a stainless steel insert embossed with hours and minutes indentations then flooded with high grade C3 SuperLuminova. The hobnail outer knurling is slightly higher than the insert to form a high grip surface for trustworthy operation even when using the palm of a wet gloved hand. Both components are matt bead blasted, hardened to 1200HV (Vickers hardness scale) then a 0.8 micron PVD coating is applied whose hardness matches that of the stainless steel components. If you'd prefer a metal bracelet, the B09 matches perfectly. N.B. this bezel is unapologetically fit for purpose. Please be aware it is likely to catch or wear shirt cuffs etc. Straps are easily changed and secured via solid steel screw in bars operated with a five lobe tool and matching socket in the strap bar ends. The recessed crown sits neatly out of harms way at 4H whilst retaining the immense water protection afforded by our proprietary triple seals. An additional screw down mechanism locks the crown into the case. The last two photos are stills taken from a video of a Holton and a Kimmeridge strapped to an ROV in the Gulf of Mexico in March 2020, still working at 3900ft - almost 3/4 mile underwater. As a piece of equipment issued by stores, the Holton has been assigned the NATO stock number 6645-99-303-0677: Time-measuring instruments; United Kingdom, and features the ' Crow's foot/Pusser's Arrow/Broad Arrow ' on the dial in subdued grey. As our way of saying thank you to serving and ex serving military personnel, we offer 20% military and 'blue light' discount on all our watches. Please email sales@elliotbrownwatches.com with proof of service and to find out more. Our returns policy is on our site here , and our five year warranty is outlined here .
